subject: CNC kickoff — learned normalized cuts for corpus clustering
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kicking off the CNC adoption. Today the retrieval side clusters corpus shards with spectral clustering — Laplacian eigenspace embedding, then k-means — and it's both slow at our scale and awkward to update incrementally. Our CNC work replaces that with a model trained to directly minimize a continuous relaxation of the expected normalized cuts objective, unsupervised, outputting cluster probabilities directly. In the paper's motivating example CNC converges to the optimal cut value (0.286 on the toy CIFAR-10 affinity graph), matching spectral clustering without the eigendecomposition.

Goal (Feb 23 – May 25): reproduce published behavior on reference datasets, then a bake-off vs the spectral pipeline on one production corpus shard — quality parity at materially lower cost is the bar.

Jelena, staffing + platform dependencies when ready.

Anders
